justification: Review of animal (rat, monkey, zebrafish) studies of prenatal cannabis/THC neurodevelopmental effects, not human primary data.
Cochrane review of memantine for autism; no cannabis or cannabinoid exposure examined.
Acute THC in humans with fear/threat extinction learning measured via EEG; memory-domain relevance is borderline but not confidently ruled out.
EVALI case report in an adolescent marijuana user; no memory outcome measured.
Protocol for a randomized clinical trial of CBD on memory reconsolidation, not a completed empirical study.
Transdermal CBD RCT for focal epilepsy with seizure frequency outcomes; no memory measure.
Randomized human trial of acute cannabis with verbal free recall (verbal memory) assessed.
RCT of CBD in cocaine use disorder assessing visual memory (Pattern Recognition Memory, CANTAB).
Book-chapter review of cannabinoid receptor mechanisms drawing largely on animal experiments.
CBD in PTSD examining reconsolidation of aversive memories and cognitive impairment; memory-outcome adequacy uncertain, conservatively retained.
CBD and recall/reconsolidation of traumatic memories in PTSD; memory-outcome measurement uncertain, conservatively retained.
Computational SARS-CoV-2 vaccine design; THC/THC here means T-helper cell, no cannabis exposure.
Oral THC impairment detection via fNIRS using tachycardia/subjective high; no memory test administered.
CBD formulations tested on facial emotion recognition, not a memory outcome.
MAGL-inhibitor study in a traumatic brain injury mouse model.
Human cannabis use disorder study measuring visual, episodic, and working memory (CANTAB).
Orexin/endocannabinoid effects on episodic memory studied in obese mice.
Observational SCI study reporting cannabis use association with working memory and free-recall performance, though cannabis is peripheral.
RCT of vaped CBD in healthy adults measuring verbal episodic memory.
Regular cannabis users assessed for visual recognition and episodic memory (CANTAB).
Cannabis urinary metabolites related to verbal memory performance (RAVLT) in young adults.
Longitudinal medical cannabis patient study assessing verbal learning/memory over 12 months.
Chronic cannabis users assessed on verbal learning and memory (CVLT-II).
Cannabis use and neurocognition study measuring working memory and verbal memory.
Longitudinal cannabis-initiation study measuring verbal learning and memory (RAVLT).
Regular cannabis users assessed for verbal working memory (Digit Span, Hopkins Verbal Learning).
Acute cannabis concentrate study measuring verbal memory errors in humans.
Cannabis-induced psychosis vs schizophrenia study measuring working and verbal memory.
Study of CNR1 gene polymorphisms and working memory in healthy volunteers; no cannabis exposure.
Adolescent cannabis-use model using working memory as an indicator; memory-as-predictor design retained conservatively.
Heroin/cannabis cortical thickness imaging discusses working-memory regions but administers no memory test.
Cannabis use study measuring working memory and short-term verbal memory in young adults.
Tobacco/cannabis longitudinal study measuring working memory in a UK cohort.
Acute synthetic cannabinoid (JWH-018) study measuring memory (SMT) in recreational users.
Psychotic-disorder cognition study where cannabis is only a covariate, not the examined exposure.
Developmental CBD exposure and memory studied in mice.
First-episode psychosis study examining cannabis consumption's influence on working memory; cannabis role secondary but examined.
Cannabis use disorder associations with verbal/working memory and brain imaging in African Americans.
CBD in treatment-resistant epilepsy with standardized neuropsychological memory and working-memory testing.
Twin study assessing concurrent cannabis use relative to episodic learning/memory; cannabis examined as confounder, conservatively retained.
Cannabis exposure and working memory deficit mediated by hippocampal volume (imaging).
Heavy cannabis users assessed for verbal learning/working memory with cortical thickness MRI.
NMDAR autoantibody study in clinical-high-risk subjects; no cannabis exposure examined.
Medical cannabis and cognitive performance (working memory, new learning) in older chronic pain patients.
Past cannabis use disorder effects on learning/memory in people living with HIV.
Sibling-comparison study of cannabis use and verbal memory in adolescents.
Narrative review of short- and long-term cannabis effects on cognition.
Meta-analysis of acute CB1 agonist effects on cognition.
Cannabis use and CNR1 polygenic index interaction on working-memory prefrontal fMRI activity.
Longitudinal SUD study including cannabis use disorder with visuospatial working-memory measures; cannabis among several substances.
